notes:
Account profile: large broadcaster + licensed archive (news, long-form transcripts, video captions).
Scale: ~2.4M source assets, avg raw length 6k-20k words (many multi-episode transcripts). Expect ~8-12M chunks with 1.5k token chunking.
Goals: replace slow keyword search, enable high-precision editorial search (person/time/topic), surface clip-level results + context window.
POC scope: two-stage retrieval (bi-encoder ANN -> cross-encoder reranker) for top-K=100 -> rerank top-10; measure latency and cost per query under production load (burst to 500 qps).
Latency targets: 95th <= 400ms for first-pass ANN; end-to-end (with cross-encoder rerank) 95th <= 900ms (soft), aim for 700ms.
Cost sensitivity: target blended cost < $0.015/query at 100 qps sustained; willing to pay more for enterprise SLA but want recommendations from Redwood Optimize on batching + quantization.
Chunking discussion notes: current strategy uses sentence-boundary chunking + 200 token overlap -> causes too many small chunks and poor recall on long narrative pieces. Team exploring adaptive chunking: variable-length anchors (semantically-aware split at paragraph/topic boundaries) and merging small chunks during index-time. Concern: overlap increases index size 15-20% and increases rerank latency.
Embeddings model: evaluating two families — high-dim text-embedding-3-large equivalent (better recall) vs cheaper 1/2 size model for serving cost. Plan: index with high-quality embeddings, store 64-bit quantized vectors for Dedicated storage to save space; keep cheaper model for online pass if needed.
Reranker tuning: prototype uses a cross-encoder finetuned on editorial Q->passage pairs (internal labels). Observed: precision@10 improved 12% but latency doubled. Working with SE to explore distilling cross-encoder to a lightweight transformer pair + score calibration. Considering cascade reranker: cheap lexical filter -> dense bi-encoder score -> lightweight scorer -> full cross-encoder for top-3 only.
Indexing & operational notes: snapshot + delta ingestion cadence daily; plan to shard by archive-year to parallelize queries. Want snapshot restore times < 2h. Need guidance on embedding reindex strategy when reranker model updates (hot-swap vs full reindex).
Security / compliance: must demonstrate SSO + audit logs, ability to restrict model access in VPC with customer KMS. Also asked about retention controls for embeddings and token-level telemetry.
Quotes: "We can't pay for recall lost to naive chunking anymore — editorial teams need sensible passages back, not 300 tiny slices."
Next demo: reranker latency profile with cascade approach (Samir + Maya to run load test week of 2026-03-03).
Drive artifacts: initial benchmark spreadsheet + sample transcripts in Drive link above.
